nodes.description: Public mapping(address => uint) balanceOf in phononfinance tracking token balances; written unchecked in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping allowance[owner][spender] in phononfinance; decremented unchecked in transferFrom and set in approve.
Public totalSupply set once in the constructor of phononfinance.
Public token name string of phononfinance.
Public token symbol string of phononfinance.
Private privileged owner address of phononfinance; gates delegate() and batchSend().
Constant internal UNI router address pre-approved in the constructor with uint(-1) allowance.
Constant public decimals = 18 of phononfinance.
Private balance mapping of the reference ERC20 implementation.
Private allowance mapping of the reference ERC20 implementation.
Private total supply of the reference ERC20 implementation.
Private name string of ERC20Detailed.
Private symbol string of ERC20Detailed.
Private decimals value of ERC20Detailed.
Public payable transfer that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable transferFrom guarded by the ensure modifier; performs unchecked allowance and balance debits/credits on caller-supplied addresses.
Public payable approve writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value with no return-value checks.
Owner-only function performing a delegatecall into a caller-supplied address with attacker-supplied calldata, giving that address full control of this contract's storage.
Owner-only mass transfer; computes total = _value * _tos.length unchecked and mutates balances in a loop while emitting mismatched Transfer events.
Internal pure deterministic Uniswap-V2 pair address computation used by the ensure modifier.
Modifier restricting _from/_to to be the owner or the hardcoded Uniswap pair; implements a transfer whitelist/blacklist gate.
Payable constructor that sets metadata, mints the whole supply to msg.sender and grants infinite allowance to the UNI router.
Reference ERC20 transfer that delegates to _transfer via _msgSender().
Reference ERC20 transferFrom that debits allowance with SafeMath and calls _transfer/_approve.
Reference ERC20 approve that calls _approve.
Reference ERC20 helper increasing allowance using SafeMath.add.
Reference ERC20 helper decreasing allowance using SafeMath.sub.
Internal ERC20 balance mutation using SafeMath add/sub and zero-address checks.
Internal ERC20 mint updating _totalSupply and _balances with SafeMath.add.
Internal ERC20 burn updating _balances and _totalSupply with SafeMath.sub.
Internal ERC20 allowance writer with zero-address checks.
Reference ERC20 view returning _totalSupply.
Reference ERC20 view returning _balances[account].
Reference ERC20 view returning _allowances[owner][spender].
Checked addition library used by the reference ERC20 implementation.
Checked subtraction library requiring b <= a.
Checked multiplication library requiring c / a == b.
Checked division library requiring b > 0.
Library view using inline assembly extcodehash to decide whether an address is a contract.
SafeERC20 wrapper encoding transfer and delegating to callOptionalReturn.
SafeERC20 wrapper encoding transferFrom and delegating to callOptionalReturn.
SafeERC20 wrapper for approve with non-zero allowance guard, delegating to callOptionalReturn.
Private helper performing a low-level call on an arbitrary token address and decoding optional return data.
Constructor storing name, symbol and decimals.
View returning _name.
View returning _symbol.
View returning _decimals.
Internal helper returning msg.sender as address payable.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization, minting in the constructor, allowance ownership and transfer authorization.
Unsafe delegatecall in delegate() that executes arbitrary attacker-supplied bytecode in this contract's storage context.
Low-level address(token).call(data) in SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn, an external call into an arbitrary token contract.
Unchecked Solidity 0.5 subtraction of _value from allowance and balanceOf[_from] in transferFrom (no SafeMath).
Unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length in batchSend allowing overflow of the total payout.
Inline assembly extcodehash in Address.isContract relying on a hardcoded account hash constant.
Unchecked addition balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom and batchSend without overflow protection.
Source address parameter of transferFrom, restricted by the ensure modifier.
Destination address parameter of transferFrom, restricted by the ensure modifier.
Amount parameter of transferFrom used in unchecked allowance/balance arithmetic.
Destination address parameter of transfer forwarded to transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transfer forwarded to transferFrom.
Spender address parameter of approve used as allowance key.
Allowance amount parameter of approve.
Target address of the owner-only delegatecall; fully attacker-chosen by the owner.
Arbitrary calldata bytes executed in the delegatecall.
Array of recipient addresses in batchSend; its length multiplies _value.
Per-recipient amount parameter of batchSend.
Source address checked by the ensure whitelist modifier.
Destination address checked by the ensure whitelist modifier.
Factory address parameter of pairFor.
First token address parameter of pairFor.
Second token address parameter of pairFor.
Name argument of the constructor.
Symbol argument of the constructor.
Initial supply argument minted to msg.sender in the constructor.
Locally sorted lower token address in pairFor.
Locally sorted higher token address in pairFor.
Computed deterministic pair address returned by pairFor.
Locally computed total = _value * _tos.length, subject to unchecked multiplication overflow.
Loop counter of the batchSend payout loop.
Loop-local recipient address extracted from _tos in batchSend.
Local pair address computed inside the ensure modifier and compared against _from; shadows the UNI state variable.

edges.reason: transfer forwards its arguments to transferFrom, making transferFrom the real settlement routine.
msg.sender becomes the _from argument of transferFrom through transfer.
_to parameter flows into the transfer body and onward to transferFrom.
_value parameter flows into the transfer body and onward to transferFrom.
_from is consumed by the ensure modifier and by the balance mutations in transferFrom.
_to is consumed by the ensure modifier and credited in transferFrom.
_value drives the unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic in transferFrom.
msg.sender is compared with _from to decide whether the allowance must be debited.
transferFrom decrements balanceOf[_from] and increments balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath.
transferFrom debits allowance[_from][msg.sender] with an unchecked subtraction after a bare require.
The allowance/balance debits in transferFrom are unchecked Solidity 0.5 subtractions.
balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom is an unchecked addition.
The ensure modifier gates every transferFrom call, restricting _from/_to to owner or the Uniswap pair.
The ensure modifier calls pairFor to derive the whitelisted pair address on every transfer.
The ensure modifier reads the privileged owner state variable to authorize transfers.
The local UNI address inside ensure is the result of pairFor(...) and is used in the require check.
Factory address argument feeds the CREATE2-style pair derivation.
tokenA argument feeds the sorted pair derivation.
tokenB argument feeds the sorted pair derivation.
pairFor assigns token0 from the sorted tokenA/tokenB comparison.
pairFor assigns token1 from the sorted tokenA/tokenB comparison.
pairFor computes and returns the pair address from the init-code hash.
_from is validated against owner or the derived pair inside the ensure modifier.
_to is validated against owner or the derived pair inside the ensure modifier.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with no authorization restriction.
approve unconditionally overwrites the caller's allowance entry.
_spender is used as the allowance key in approve.
_value is written as the new allowance in approve.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing arbitrary code.
delegate authenticates the caller against the owner state variable.
delegate performs a delegatecall into an address and calldata chosen by the owner, executing foreign code with this contract's storage.
Parameter a is the delegatecall target in delegate.
Parameter b is the arbitrary delegatecall payload in delegate.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before mass-minting balances to arbitrary addresses.
batchSend authenticates the caller against the owner state variable.
batchSend mutates balanceOf entries in an unbounded loop.
total = _value * _tos.length is computed without SafeMath and can overflow.
balanceOf[_to] += _value inside the batchSend loop is an unchecked addition.
_tos supplies the recipients and the loop bound for batchSend.
_value is multiplied by the array length and credited per recipient.
The local total is the product of _value and _tos.length used for the balance check.
Loop counter i controls the batchSend iteration.
The loop-local _to is extracted from _tos and used as the balance credit key.
The constructor makes msg.sender the owner and the sole initial holder of the entire supply.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing privileged control.
Constructor assigns the immutable totalSupply.
Constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the whole supply.
Constructor grants uint(-1) allowance to the hardcoded UNI router address.
Constructor stores the token name.
Constructor stores the token symbol.
Constructor name argument is written to the name state variable.
Constructor symbol argument is written to the symbol state variable.
Constructor supply argument becomes totalSupply and the initial balance.
ERC20.transfer obtains the sender from _msgSender(), which returns msg.sender.
ERC20.transfer delegates balance movement to _transfer.
ERC20.transferFrom delegates balance movement to _transfer.
ERC20.transferFrom re-approves the residual allowance through _approve.
ERC20.approve delegates the allowance write to _approve.
_transfer reads and writes the ERC20 _balances mapping.
_transfer uses SafeMath.sub to guard against balance underflow.
_transfer uses SafeMath.add to guard against balance overflow.
_mint increases _totalSupply with SafeMath.add.
_mint credits the target ERC20 balance.
_burn debits the ERC20 balance with SafeMath.sub.
_burn decreases _totalSupply with SafeMath.sub.
_approve writes the ERC20 _allowances mapping.
ERC20.balanceOf reads the _balances mapping.
ERC20.allowance reads the _allowances mapping.
ERC20.totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
increaseAllowance uses SafeMath.add on the allowance value.
decreaseAllowance uses SafeMath.sub on the allowance value.
_msgSender returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
ERC20.transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is debited.
isContract relies on inline assembly extcodehash to detect contract accounts.
safeTransfer forwards the encoded call to callOptionalReturn.
safeTransferFrom forwards the encoded call to callOptionalReturn.
safeApprove forwards the encoded call to callOptionalReturn.

callOptionalReturn requires address(token).isContract() before making the external call.

ERC20Detailed constructor stores _symbol.
ERC20Detailed constructor stores _decimals.
name() view returns _name.
symbol() view returns _symbol.
decimals() view returns _decimals.

normalization_plan.reason: The _from parameter only exists as input to transferFrom and is consumed by the ensure gate and balance debit.
The _to parameter only exists as input to transferFrom and is used for the balance credit.
The _value parameter only feeds the unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic inside transferFrom.
The _to parameter of the thin transfer wrapper is forwarded straight to transferFrom.
The _value parameter of the thin transfer wrapper is forwarded straight to transferFrom.
The _spender parameter is only used as the allowance mapping key inside approve.
The _value parameter is only written into the allowance mapping inside approve.
Parameter a is the target of the unsafe delegatecall and has no meaning outside it.
Parameter b is the calldata executed by the unsafe delegatecall.
_tos provides both the recipients and the loop length used for the unchecked total computation.
_value is the per-recipient amount multiplied into the unchecked total.
The _from parameter exists solely to be compared against owner and the derived pair inside ensure.
The _to parameter exists solely to be compared against owner and the derived pair inside ensure.
The factory parameter is only fed into the pair address derivation.
tokenA is only used for the ordering comparison in pairFor.
tokenB is only used for the ordering comparison in pairFor.
The name argument is only stored into the name state variable during construction.
The symbol argument is only stored into the symbol state variable during construction.
The supply argument only initializes totalSupply and the deployer balance.
token0 is a temporary sorted value used only inside pairFor.
token1 is a temporary sorted value used only inside pairFor.
The pair local is the return value of pairFor and has no independent role.
The local total is exactly the unchecked product _value * _tos.length flagged by the unsafe operation.
The loop counter i only controls the batchSend payout loop.
The loop-local _to is only the current recipient inside the batchSend loop.
The local UNI address is evaluated only inside the ensure modifier's require check.
